newsitem.title: GERMANY: No German bids at EU grain tender due holiday.
newsitem.headline: No German bids at EU grain tender due holiday.

text.p: German grain traders will not be able to submit export bids to the European Union cereals management committee on Thursday as state intervention board BLE in Frankfurt is closed for the Corpus Christi holiday.
Internationally operating grain houses would be able to place bids through intervention authorities in EU countries unaffected by the holidays, traders said.
But many offices were shut because the holiday is observed in six western German states with a majority Catholic population and in parts of Saxony and Thuringia in the East.
